name: Life Day: Second Weekend
description: Help restore the Tree of Life with Life Orbs. Complete the tree to start a 60-second loot phase.
details: Collect Life Orbs together to restore the Tree of Life. The tree needs 100 Life; each orb contributes 1 to 6 Life depending on its tier.
Completing the tree starts a 60-second Sandcrawler loot phase with special droid rarity and variant rolls.
After the loot phase, the tree resets so you can restore it again while the event is active.
Your Life Day Event Pass from the previous weekend still works.
Thermal Imploders cannot be picked up during Life Day.
Times are shown in your local timezone.
